questions.text: Pick the correct answer: Which attribute of supplies multiple resolutions for responsive images?
questions.explanation: srcset lists candidate image sources at various resolutions.

questions.text: Which HTML element is used for the header of a page or section?
questions.explanation: <header> represents introductory content for a page or section.

questions.text: What is the appropriate HTML element for sample output from a program?
questions.explanation: <samp> represents sample output.

questions.text: Which HTML element is used for the footer of a page or section?
questions.explanation: <footer> holds information like authorship, related links, and copyright.

questions.text: Which HTML element is used for a summary for a <details> widget?
questions.explanation: <summary> provides a visible heading for <details>.

questions.text: To mark up user input such as key presses, which HTML tag should you use?
questions.explanation: <kbd> represents user input.

questions.text: Select the correct element for a fallback container for scripts and data not rendered.
questions.explanation: <template> stores markup that is not rendered until used via JavaScript.

questions.text: To mark up content tangential to the main content (like a sidebar), which HTML tag should you use?
questions.explanation: <aside> holds content indirectly related to the main content.

questions.text: Select the correct element for the primary content area.
questions.explanation: <main> contains the dominant content of the <body>.

questions.text: To mark up a variable in a mathematical expression, which HTML tag should you use?
questions.explanation: <var> represents the name of a variable.

questions.text: In a document, what tag represents a modal dialog box?
questions.explanation: <dialog> represents a dialog box or window.

questions.text: Select the correct element for highlighted or marked text.
questions.explanation: <mark> highlights text as a reference or for emphasis.

questions.text: Select the correct element for a container for external content like plug-ins.
questions.explanation: <object> embeds external resources; parameters are set using <param>.

questions.text: To mark up a single column within a column group, which HTML tag should you use?
questions.explanation: <col> represents a column; often styled via the span attribute.

questions.text: What is the appropriate HTML element for a group of one or more columns in a table?
questions.explanation: <colgroup> groups columns for formatting.

questions.text: Which HTML element is used for the main navigation of a page?
questions.explanation: Use <nav> to represent a set of navigation links.

questions.text: For subscript text, choose the correct HTML tag.
questions.explanation: <sub> displays subscript text.

questions.text: In a document, what tag represents alternate content when scripting is disabled?
questions.explanation: <noscript> provides fallback content when scripts are disabled or unsupported.

questions.text: In a document, what tag represents inserted text?
questions.explanation: <ins> represents inserted text; often rendered with an underline.

questions.text: For a short inline quotation, choose the correct HTML tag.
questions.explanation: <q> is for short inline quotations; browsers may add quotation marks.

questions.text: To ensures media playback repeats continuously, which attribute should you use?
questions.explanation: loop causes audio/video to restart when it ends.

questions.text: What attribute is used to disables built-in form validation on submit?
questions.explanation: Use the boolean novalidate attribute on <form> to disable HTML5 validation.

questions.text: Select the attribute that specifies an input pattern using a regular expression.
questions.explanation: pattern uses a JavaScript-style regular expression to validate input.

questions.text: In HTML forms, which attribute sets the HTTP method for form submission?
questions.explanation: method is typically 'get' (default) or 'post'.

questions.text: Which HTML attribute associates an input with a form by id even if not nested?
questions.explanation: The form attribute lets a control be outside the <form> element.

questions.text: In HTML forms, which attribute enables or disables the browser's spell checker?
questions.explanation: spellcheck accepts 'true' or 'false' to control spell checking.

questions.text: In HTML forms, which attribute preselects an option in a dropdown?
questions.explanation: selected indicates the initially chosen <option>.

questions.text: To sets the legal number intervals for a numeric input, which attribute should you use?
questions.explanation: step defines increments for numeric/range inputs.

questions.text: In HTML forms, which attribute sets the display language of an element?
questions.explanation: lang declares the language for content (e.g., 'en', 'fr').

questions.text: Select the attribute that declares that a script is a JavaScript module.
questions.explanation: type='module' loads the script as a module with import/export support.

questions.text: Which HTML attribute defines the viewport configuration for responsive design?
questions.explanation: Use <meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1'>.

questions.text: To marks an element as editable by the user, which attribute should you use?
questions.explanation: contenteditable enables in-place editing of element content.
